mentions.name: AML for macOS
mentions.description: A collection of native AI/ML operators for TouchDesigner on macOS, combining TouchDesigner's node-based interface with features known from ComfyUI. It leans on macOS-exclusive frameworks to bring AI/ML capabilities to TouchDesigner and make the Mac a viable platform for this kind of creative AI work.
mentions.problem: TouchDesigner on the Mac has always been underserved for AI/ML work.
mentions.audience: TouchDesigner users on macOS, particularly media creators and artists
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a collection of native AI/ML operators for TouchDesigner on macOS. Think of it as a happy marriage between the interface of TouchDesigner but with some of the features you know from ComfyUI.

evidence.value: I've been working on a collection of native AI/ML operators for TouchDesigner on macOS. Think of it as a happy marriage between the interface of TouchDesigner but with some of the features you know from ComfyUI.
